title: Remaining LTP network syscall blockers
summary: Track the remaining explicit blockers after the LTP network syscall split: SCTP, RDS, TCP TLS ULP, RV64 socketcall interpretation, accept03 fd providers, and the recvmmsg01 musl wrapper SIGSEGV. The constrained TLS ULP setsockopt10 phase is complete and refreshed b6 to 10/11. Local-only RDS and SCTP protocol-surface phases are complete; refreshed b2/b3/b4 rows now report 35/35, 37/38, and 91/95, moving the split aggregate to 227/236. The pidfd_open, memfd_create, inotify_init1/fanotify_init, and scoped fsopen/fspick/open_tree accept03 provider slices are complete and move b4 accept03 to 20/23; pidfd_send_signal, perf_event_open, bpf, and memfd_secret remain pending or explicitly heavy/out of scope.

write_sets.notes: Owns TLS ULP metadata, local-only SCTP/RDS protocol state, socket errno/order rules, and focused socket host tests.
Owns principled fd providers for accept03, especially pidfd, memfd, inotify/fanotify notification fds, and new mount API fds.
Owns progress docs, score interpretation, witness paths, and split-batch refreshes.

steps.title: Audit docs and LTP source for each remaining blocker
verification: Read the design/progress docs listed under context.design_docs and context.progress_refs.
Read LTP accept03/tst_fd, bind04, sendto02, recvmsg03, setsockopt10, socketcall01..03, and recvmmsg01 sources.
steps.notes: The audit classifies the blockers as: unsupported protocol surfaces (SCTP/RDS/TLS ULP), broader fd-provider work (accept03), non-RV64 ABI surface (socketcall), and non-kernel musl wrapper SIGSEGV (recvmmsg01 musl).

steps.title: Close the non-kernel or non-RV64 interpretation items
verification: Confirm no NR_socketcall exists for the RV64 generic syscall table.
Rerun or cite the glibc recvmmsg01 witness: timeout 180s cargo xtask oscomp qemu --target rv64-qemu --data target/oscomp/ltp-glibc-recvmmsg --boot-suite ltp-glibc.
Keep raw recvmmsg host tests passing: cargo test -p tx-shims --lib dispatch_sendmmsg_recvmmsg_error_order_matches_socket_abi -- --test-threads=1.
steps.notes: socketcall01..03 should remain architecture-surface blockers on RV64 unless a 32-bit compat ABI is chartered. recvmmsg01 musl should not be fixed in the kernel because the musl wrapper writes to LTP's PROT_NONE bad address before issuing the second syscall; use raw and glibc witnesses for kernel semantics.

steps.title: Refresh accept03 provider inventory and fd error contract
steps.notes: Inventory refreshed before pidfd_open work: accept03 baseline was 13/23 and skipped pidfd_open, fanotify, inotify, perf event, bpf map, fsopen, fspick, open_tree, memfd, and memfd_secret. accept03 expects ENOTSOCK for real non-socket open files and EBADF for O_PATH/open_tree-style fds without a normal file object. Existing OpenFileBacking values are classified generically rather than by test name.

steps.title: Implement pidfd_open and pidfd_send_signal as signal bus adapter fds
steps.notes: pidfd_open sub-slice complete: NR_PIDFD_OPEN now dispatches, resolves ProcessIdentity, installs OpenFileBacking::Pidfd, sets FD_CLOEXEC, accepts PIDFD_NONBLOCK, and makes accept03 pass pidfd as ENOTSOCK. Focused accept03 is 14/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-pidfd-open-final.txt. pidfd_send_signal and pidfd wait/readiness semantics remain pending; SIGNAL_v1 still points to ProcessIdentity exit publication for the later readiness path.

steps.title: Implement memfd_create using PageBacked anonymous RNodes
steps.notes: Complete as a basic ordinary memfd provider: NR_MEMFD_CREATE dispatches to an anonymous PageContainerKind::Anon wrapped in a synthetic regular-file RNode with no path-namespace presence, supports MFD_CLOEXEC, and rejects MFD_ALLOW_SEALING/MFD_HUGETLB until file seals and huge-page-backed memfds exist. Focused accept03 is 15/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-memfd-create.txt; memfd_create02 is 10/14 in target/oscomp/ltp-memfd-create02-basic.txt with seal/hugetlb subcases skipped as unsupported.

steps.title: Implement basic inotify/fanotify notification fds without permission delegation
steps.notes: Complete as typed instance-fd support: inotify_init1 and fanotify_init install VFS StructPayload::FsNotify descriptors with zone-managed instance identity, VFS read wait source, CLOEXEC/NONBLOCK flag plumbing, and generic non-socket accept() classification. Focused accept03 is 17/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-fsnotify-fds.txt; inotify_init1_01/inotify_init1_02 are 8/8 in target/oscomp/ltp-inotify-init1-basic.txt. Full watch/mark event queues and fanotify permission events remain future fsnotify/OnAgent work.

steps.title: Stage scoped fsopen/fspick/open_tree fd providers
steps.notes: Complete as a scoped fd-provider phase: NR_FSOPEN, NR_FSPICK, and NR_OPEN_TREE dispatch, validate flags/paths, install OpenFileBacking::MountApi descriptors, and classify accept03 errno generically (fsopen/fspick ENOTSOCK, open_tree EBADF). MOUNT_v1 now records that full fsconfig/fsmount/move_mount/mount_setattr topology and superblock semantics remain deferred. Focused accept03 is 20/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-mount-api-fds.txt; remaining skips are perf event, bpf map, and memfd_secret.

steps.title: Keep perf_event_open, bpf, and memfd_secret behind explicit charters
verification: Document the remaining TCONF lines after pidfd, memfd, and notify-fd phases.
steps.notes: SYSCALL_STATUS marks bpf/perf_event_open as out of scope v1, and memfd_secret is a VM/secret-memory feature rather than ordinary memfd. Do not add descriptor shells for these just to gain accept03 points.

steps.title: Implement constrained TCP TLS ULP metadata for setsockopt10
steps.notes: Completed as constrained metadata support: setsockopt10 checks CONFIG_TLS, sets TCP_ULP to "tls", applies SOL_TLS/TLS_TX crypto info, disconnects with AF_UNSPEC, then expects listen() on a disconnected TLS socket to fail EINVAL. The kernel now advertises CONFIG_TLS=y after socket state tracks a TLS ULP context and step_listen rejects ULP-without-clone. This phase does not implement encrypted data records.

steps.title: Implement local AF_RDS SOCK_SEQPACKET loopback sufficient for recvmsg03
steps.notes: Complete as a local-only RDS provider: AF_RDS SOCK_SEQPACKET creates a real socket kind, bind owns an RDS endpoint, sendmsg/sendto to a bound local peer enqueues a packet with source metadata, recvmsg returns the source endpoint so the existing shim clamps msg_namelen to sizeof(sockaddr_in), and close withdraws the endpoint. Focused recvmsg03 is 1/1 in target/oscomp/ltp-recvmsg03-rds-after-ipv6tcp.txt. Full RDS wire/external-network behavior remains out of scope.

steps.title: Implement local-only SCTP stream/seqpacket association semantics
steps.notes: Complete as local-only SCTP association semantics: IPPROTO_SCTP stream sockets create over IPv4/IPv6, bind/listen/connect/accept use separate SCTP endpoint tables, connected peers exchange bytes through local queues, readiness/close cleanup is wired, and SCTP endpoint/autobind helpers keep SCTP independent from TCP. Focused sendto02,bind04 is 17/17 in target/oscomp/ltp-sctp-sendto02-bind04-after-ipv6tcp-submit.txt. Enabling SCTP exposed later bind04 IPv6 TCP rows, so RawTcp loopback now supports IPv6 smoltcp endpoints/segments and has a [::1] TCP host regression test. Full SCTP chunks, multihoming, wire format, and external NIC behavior remain out of scope.

steps.title: Refresh focused and split-batch witnesses after each landed phase
steps.notes: RDS/SCTP refresh complete for the affected rows: b2 35/35 in target/oscomp/ltp-net-b2-after-rds-sctp.txt, b3 37/38 in target/oscomp/ltp-net-b3-after-rds-sctp.txt, and b4 91/95 in target/oscomp/ltp-net-b4-after-rds-sctp.txt. Together with unchanged b1 40/40, b5 14/17, and b6 10/11, the split aggregate is now 227/236. Remaining misses are recvmmsg01 musl SIGSEGV, RV64 legacy socketcall/accept4 socketcall interpretation, accept03 heavy providers, and setsockopt03 compat-only coverage.

verification.notes: Read current network progress, recvmmsg musl/glibc research, syscall status, and related Txv3/VFS/Process/PageBacked/Mount/Device design docs.
Read accept03/tst_fd, bind04, sendto02, recvmsg03, setsockopt10, socketcall01..03, and recvmmsg01 sources from the local LTP tree.

TLS ULP metadata phase passed host tests, focused LTP setsockopt10 1/1 in target/oscomp/ltp-setsockopt10-tls-ulp-rebuilt.txt, and refreshed b6 10/11 in target/oscomp/ltp-net-b6-after-tls-ulp.txt. pidfd_open passed host pidfd_open tests and focused LTP accept03 14/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-pidfd-open-final.txt. memfd_create passed host memfd_create tests, focused LTP accept03 15/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-memfd-create.txt, and memfd_create02 10/14 in target/oscomp/ltp-memfd-create02-basic.txt. inotify_init1/fanotify_init passed host tests, focused LTP accept03 17/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-fsnotify-fds.txt, and inotify_init1_01/inotify_init1_02 8/8 in target/oscomp/ltp-inotify-init1-basic.txt. Scoped fsopen/fspick/open_tree fd providers passed host mount/fspick dispatch tests, focused LTP accept03 20/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-accept03-after-mount-api-fds.txt, and refreshed b4 accept03 20/23 in target/oscomp/ltp-net-b4-after-rds-sctp.txt. RDS/SCTP local protocol phases passed host rds_sctp tests, the IPv6 TCP loopback regression, focused recvmsg03 1/1 in target/oscomp/ltp-recvmsg03-rds-after-ipv6tcp.txt, focused sendto02,bind04 17/17 in target/oscomp/ltp-sctp-sendto02-bind04-after-ipv6tcp-submit.txt, and refreshed b2/b3/b4 rows 35/35, 37/38, and 91/95. pidfd_send_signal and the heavy perf/bpf/memfd_secret fd-provider phases remain pending.

risks: SCTP and RDS can become misleading if implemented as descriptor shells. Any local-only provider must have explicit protocol-state, queue, readiness, and errno behavior, plus documented external-network non-goals.
TLS ULP must not flip /proc/config.gz to CONFIG_TLS=y until TCP_ULP and SOL_TLS/TLS_TX state exists; otherwise setsockopt10 would pass the kconfig gate and fail as TBROK.
accept03 has high score value but pulls in non-network subsystems. Keep provider phases independent and do not let them change socket accept behavior beyond generic non-socket fd classification.
perf_event_open and bpf are marked out of scope v1 in SYSCALL_STATUS; implementing fake fds would distort later heavy-batch work.
socketcall is absent from the Linux RV64 generic ABI. Adding it would be a compatibility-ABI project, not a network stack fix.
recvmmsg01 musl faults in userspace before syscall entry; kernel fixes would either be ineffective or would weaken VM protection.
blockers: No active design document specifies full SCTP, full RDS, or TLS record encryption. The landed RDS/SCTP phases are local syscall-surface witnesses, not full protocol stacks.
MOUNT_v1 now allows scoped fsopen/fspick/open_tree fd providers, but still defers full fsconfig/fsmount/move_mount/mount_setattr semantics.
fanotify permission events require OnAgent/FanotifyPerm plumbing from TXV3-DELEGATE-V1 and should not be bundled with a basic notification fd.
